scenes.setting: The deal closes by candlelight: 400 pounds to Black Snake, the rotting black ear to Klein — with the apothecary's gallows-humor warnings — then the gathering disperses one by one, three minutes apart
scenes.text_anchor: He took out a small wooden box, bent down, and placed it on the ground.

scenes.setting: Back through the Bravehearts kitchen: Kaspars is relieved to see him alive, promises word of future gatherings — and Klein steers well clear of Maric's card room
scenes.text_anchor: “I'm delighted that you could come back.”

scenes.setting: In the card room, Maric's four Kings lose to a zombie's four Sixes — he staggers out coughing dark blue, orders the room sealed till dawn, and drinks alone
scenes.text_anchor: Inside the card room, Maric had gone all-in and confidently flipped open his cards.

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog (visions only: a Listener swelling and blackening in the divination): the black ear channels the True Creator's foul voice — tentacles burst from Klein's veins, the fog holds, and the stripped madness fuses into a sealed charm he names Language of Foulness
scenes.text_anchor: he started to summon himself. He responded to himself and brought the wooden box containing the black ear
